text: Chocolate ready milk, and cacao parts, are prohibi bit to be imported from my part beyond the areas. If made and sold in Great Britain, it pays inland duty to do fó, perils we anticipate; it must be included in papers containing one pond each, and produced at the excise office to be stumped. Upon three days too- ties give to the official of excluse, private families may make chocolate for their own use, provided no less than half an hundred weight of nuts be made at one time.
